name: Detail Kernel Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses KernelPlantRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-052, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route files)

Target Operasional table queried DIRECTLY by DetailKernelPlant::render() (KernelPlantOperationalTarget::orderBy('sort_order')->get()) -- NOT part of the GET /api/kernel-plant-records/{id} response -- per this screen's tech-spec direction, mirrors DetailThreshing/DetailPressing exactly; renders 3 columns (Equipment / Parameter, Target Benchmark, Corrective Action Plan) matching Threshing's/Pressing's shape, NOT Depricarping's 4-column shape -- UNTOUCHED by this revision

Detail grid table renders all 9 reading columns (Ripple Mill 1/2, Claybath/Hydro SG, Kernel Silo 1/2 Temp, Kernel Moisture, Shell Loss, Downtime (Mins), Findings) -- STRUCTURAL SHAPE MATCHES DEPRICARPING's split Downtime Mins + Findings columns, not Threshing/Pressing's single Downtime Reason column -- UNTOUCHED by this revision
Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewKernelPlantView.vue's detail mode exactly, per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/kernel-plant/{id} registered after /data/kernel-plant/create (screen-060) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

REVISED 2026-08-24 (documentation-only correction, no functional code change needed -- Kernel Plant is the LAST of the 4 new stations to receive this fix): the Blade view (kernel-plant-detail.blade.php) already iterated $record['details'] directly with a plain @foreach and never assumed exactly 24 rows, so it required zero changes for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision to KernelPlantRecordService -- it correctly renders however many rows a record actually has, confirmed by grep (no '24' literal in the view), mirrors DetailDepricarping's (screen-055) identical finding. This is the last of the 6 Kernel Plant screens to be re-verified, completing the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-row migration across all 4 new stations (Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant) and all 24 of their screens.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DetailKernelPlantTest.php) was authored but not executed against the Laravel Livewire app in this pass -- verified only by static review, consistent with every other backend Browser/* spec in this codebase. This screen required no functional changes for the entity-catalog v12 revision, so its Browser spec was left untouched.
